order_rule.rule: rootcause_taxonomy.classify_cell: an introduced cell (class coarser than its clean level) that no cause rule matches, with class DIFF and clean level E1 or E4, is counted as propagated

scale_paired.definition: all scored cells of the conf_5x notebooks at 5x (conf_5x) and 1x (conf_1x), pooled shares; percentile interval of the 5x-minus-1x change over notebook resamples (the same notebooks on both sides)
